_comment: Corrections from the independent source-claim review (agent F2, see docs/independent_review_F2.md). Original agent statements are preserved in data/raw_agent_returns; corrections are appended to notes and enumerated fields are set. Applied by pipeline/scripts/ingest_agent_returns.py.

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): FRED restrictions on storing/caching FRED content and AI/ML use are supported by FRED's announcement and legal-notice text, but the API Terms of Use page was not read. Human must read https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/terms_of_use.html. Project rule unchanged: use FRED only to discover series ids; ingest values from bls.gov.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 3 PARTLY: restriction is real (announcement + legal notice) but the API terms page itself was not read

set.title: FRED: PPI ready-mix concrete series (WPU1333 NSA primary; WPS1333 SA stale; PCU327320327320 industry cross-check) - ids to verify

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): primary escalation series is WPU1333 (NSA, monthly, 1982=100; same data as WPU133301). WPS1333 (SA twin) last value seen Sep 2025 - looks stale, do not use. WPS133301 NOT FOUND. Register title's 'PCU3273232732' not seen in any result (probable typo for PCU327320327320 = industry-based NAICS 327320 series, a cross-check only). WPU13330101D (West region) is an UNVERIFIED candidate for Los Angeles. A human must open the series pages before any ingestion. Values must not be stored from FRED.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 4: identifier dispute resolved partly; 'PCU3273232732' not seen anywhere

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): Agent A1's 'WPS133301' (SA ready-mix PPI, 'Apr 2026: 391.392') could not be found - do not use it. 'Latest values seen' in agent text (e.g. WPUID612 Feb 2026) are stale snapshots and are not stored; re-pull from bls.gov at ingestion time.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 4 / X2: WPS133301 not verifiable; 'latest values' are stale

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): 'ECICONWAG' is a FRED-style alias; BLS-native ECI series ids look like CIU.../CIS.... The BLS-native id of the construction wages-and-salaries series was NOT seen. Read https://www.bls.gov/eci/factsheets/eci-series-id-guide.htm before API ingestion; the stored series_code will fail against the BLS API as it stands.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 4: ECICONWAG is a FRED alias, not a BLS-native id

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): the clause on homedepot.com itself is NOT known. Provisional operating rule = no automated access (manual capture only) until a person reads the live Terms of Use and https://www.homedepot.com/c/faqs/legal-and-ethical-policies/ and pastes the clause here.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 5 NOT VERIFIABLE: the main homedepot.com clause was never seen; three Home Depot properties prohibit scraping

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): the statement that no robots.txt was found is WRONG. https://www.grainger.com/robots.txt exists and blocks named AI/SEO crawlers (including GPTBot and ClaudeBot) site-wide. The Terms of Access clause is still not verified; provisional operating rule = manual capture only.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claim 5 CONTRADICTED: register said no robots.txt; one exists and blocks named AI/SEO crawlers site-wide

source_corrections.append_notes: CORRECTION (reviewer F2): Dunn-Edwards terms exist at https://www.dunnedwards.com/terms-of-use/ (not read; no automation clause seen). Copying data sheets is not licensed; recording individual values as cited facts looks low risk. EVEREST VOC '2 g/L' came from an older sheet: the Oct 2024 PDS (EVER10-EN-PDS-1024) says <5 g/L (RAVOC <3 g/L). EVER10 also exists as EVER10-EN-PDS-1024.pdf. RULE: store the data-sheet revision date with every manufacturer value. 1.5 mil DFT and 375-425 sq ft/gal are not contradicted but not confirmed on a current sheet.
source_corrections.reason: F2 claims 5/12: ToS exists; VOC 2 g/L contradicted by the Oct 2024 sheet
